quest.title: Meet the Alchemist
quest.description: The Archmage has fallen ill. Meet the Alchemist at the tower to find a cure.
quest.requirements: Click the alchemist in the tower

quest.title: Collect Ingredients
quest.description: The Alchemist has given you a list of ingredients needed for the cure. Collect them and return to the Alchemist.
quest.requirements: defeat goblins and ogres to collect the required ingredients

quest.title: Return to the Alchemist
quest.description: Return to the Alchemist with the collected ingredients.
quest.requirements: Return to the Alchemist with the collected ingredients
